title: Luminaires — General Safety Requirements
scope: General safety construction requirements applicable to all classes of luminaires, including outdoor and street-lighting fixtures.

certification.reason: Certain luminaire categories are notified under CRS depending on classification.
certification.action: Verify current CRS notification for the exact product category.

title: LED Luminaires for General Lighting — Performance Requirements
scope: Photometric, electrical and thermal performance requirements specific to LED-based luminaires used for general and outdoor lighting.

certification.reason: LED lighting products are commonly notified under the CRS scheme.
certification.action: Confirm against the latest CRS product list before publishing the tender.

title: Method of Test for LED Luminaires — Photometric, Electrical & Thermal Characteristics
supersededNote: The 2013 edition has been revised; the 2021 edition includes an updated thermal-stability test procedure.
scope: Laboratory test methods for verifying luminous efficacy, colour rendering index and thermal stability of LED luminaires.

certification.reason: Test-method standard; not independently certifiable.

title: Luminaires — Particular Requirements: Street Lighting Luminaires
scope: Additional particular safety and performance requirements specific to luminaires intended for street and area lighting.

certification.reason: Falls within the same product family typically covered by CRS.
certification.action: Verify applicability before finalising tender documents.

title: Luminaires — Safety of Electrical Construction
scope: Electrical safety requirements for the construction of luminaires, covering insulation, earthing and protection against electric shock.

certification.reason: Safety construction standard; assessed as part of the parent product certification.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Street Lighting System — Specification
scope: System-level specification for solar-powered street lighting including panel, battery, luminaire and controller integration.

certification.reason: Solar lighting systems may require MNRE-approved component lists in addition to BIS compliance.
certification.action: Verify current MNRE / BIS applicability for the specific system configuration.

title: Secondary Cells & Batteries for Solar Photovoltaic Lighting Systems
scope: Performance and safety requirements for batteries used in solar street-lighting and similar off-grid systems.

certification.reason: Battery cells for lighting applications may fall under compulsory registration.

title: Glossary of Terms Relating to Illuminating Engineering
scope: Standard terminology used across Indian lighting and illumination standards.

certification.reason: Terminology standard.

title: Tubular Steel Poles — General Requirements (Street Lighting Poles)
scope: Design, material and dimensional requirements for tubular steel poles used for street-lighting installation.

certification.reason: Structural component standard.

title: Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures (IP Code)
scope: Classification and test methods for the degree of protection of electrical enclosures against dust and water ingress — relevant for outdoor, weather-exposed equipment.

certification.reason: Environmental test-method standard.

title: Stainless Steel Water Storage Tanks — Specification
supersededNote: The 1991 edition has been revised; the 2015 edition updates sheet-thickness and joint requirements.
scope: Material, fabrication and dimensional requirements for stainless-steel water storage tanks.

certification.reason: Certain tank capacities/materials may fall under mandatory ISI marking.
certification.action: Confirm the applicable QCO / ISI-mark notification for this tank category.

title: Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Acceptable and permissible limits for physical, chemical and biological parameters of drinking water — relevant to potable-water storage applications.

certification.reason: Water-quality standard, not a product certification.

title: Hot-Dip Zinc Coating on Mild Steel Tubes — Specification
scope: Coating specification for corrosion protection of steel components used in water-storage and allied structures.

certification.reason: Material coating standard.

title: Methods of Sampling & Test (Physical & Chemical) for Water & Wastewater
scope: Test methods for sampling and analysing water quality parameters.

certification.reason: Test-method standard.

title: Fire Check Doors — Specification: Metal Doors
scope: Construction, material and performance requirements for metal fire check doors used in institutional and public buildings.

certification.reason: Fire doors in public/educational buildings are typically subject to state fire regulations in addition to IS compliance.
certification.action: Verify applicable state Fire NOC requirements alongside IS compliance.

title: Fire Check Doors — Specification: Timber Doors
scope: Construction and performance requirements for timber fire check doors.

certification.reason: Same regulatory basis as metal fire doors.

title: Fire Resistance Test for Door Assemblies — Method of Test
scope: Standard fire-resistance test procedure for door assemblies, used to assign fire-rating duration.

certification.reason: Test-method standard.

title: Door Closers (Hydraulically Regulated) — Specification
scope: Performance requirements for door-closer hardware, relevant to fire-door assemblies requiring self-closing action.

certification.reason: Hardware component standard.

title: Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps for Clear, Cold & Slightly Contaminated Water — Specification
scope: Design, material and performance specification for horizontal centrifugal pumps used in water-supply applications.

certification.reason: No mandatory BIS certification scheme currently identified for this general pump category in the demo dataset.
certification.action: Re-verify against the current QCO list for the specific pump type.

title: Code for Acceptance Test for Centrifugal, Mixed-Flow & Axial Pumps
scope: Acceptance-test procedures for verifying pump performance parameters such as head, flow and efficiency.

certification.reason: Test-method standard.

title: Line-Operated Three-Phase A.C. Induction Motors — Efficiency Classes & Performance
scope: Efficiency classification and performance requirements for induction motors, including those driving pump sets.

certification.reason: Electric motors may be covered under energy-efficiency labelling requirements.

title: Rotating Electrical Machines — Rating & Performance
scope: General rating and performance requirements for rotating electrical machines used to drive pump sets.

certification.reason: General electrical machine standard.
